nonblockingFindings: Anchor removal loses in-page navigation precision: the four fragment repairs (#clm-0195…, #clm-0187…, #clm-0186--…, #source-discrepancies-and-dispositions) now point to whole notes rather than specific headings. The disposition text ('retains its same target note and visible label') is accurate but the rationale for removing rather than repairing the anchors (e.g., linter not resolving heading fragments, or the double-hyphen slug in the CLM-0186 anchor) is not recorded. Recommend documenting the reason in the migration README or restoring heading links in a form the linter accepts.

The GitHub tree-API verification of arc-zkir commit fd1c24e1… is asserted in the narrative but no receipt/response is included in the packet; likewise 'CLM-0601 already cites this commit' cannot be confirmed because the unchanged claim text is outside the diff. The strict lint does not evidence external URL reachability, so the 23 rewritten links are validated only syntactically here.

Equivalence between the working tree checked by verify-preservation.py (18:08:29Z) and the staged tree f9807010… exported for the fresh-checkout run (18:09:51Z) is not asserted (no `git status --porcelain` empty check or tree-hash comparison). Recommend recording that the index and working tree matched at both timestamps.

Artifacts referenced but not supplied: catalog-cleanup.json and the local backup for the removed wiki/canvases/index.md, raw/sources/claude-obsidian-2026-09-07/receipt.json (tool pin ad67087c… vs. installed doctor version 2.1.1 / engine 1.1.1), and evidence/obsidian-migration-2026-09-07/README.md. Their existence is inferred from cross-references only.

Link-style inconsistency: .obsidian/app.json sets useMarkdownLinks=true and newLinkFormat=absolute, but the newly added index navigation and log entry use wikilinks ([[wiki/overview|…]]) while legacy bodies use relative Markdown links. The linter accepts both, but future Obsidian-authored links will be vault-absolute Markdown, producing three coexisting styles. Consider normalising the two new additions to Markdown links for consistency with the configured policy.

Machine-specific absolute paths (/home/charl/…, /tmp/moriarty-vault-checkout-…, \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu-26.04\…) are embedded in docs/OBSIDIAN.md and committed evidence JSON. Acceptable for a personal repo, but they will be published; the portable-install section mitigates but does not remove the coupling.

The checker only covers .md files under wiki/ at baseline; non-Markdown wiki artifacts and docs/ research files targeted by legacy relative links are covered only indirectly via the dead-link lint, not by a preservation hash. A `git diff --stat BASE` summary would close this gap cheaply.

The 'occurrences' counts in portable-link-repairs.json (2 and 23) are not asserted by the script; I verified them manually against the diff (2 graph.json; 8 prose + 15 table = 23 arc-zkir) and they match.
Desktop GUI behaviour (Open folder as vault, Canvas rendering, graph filter path:wiki, ignore filters) remains unverified, as the packet itself acknowledges.
